diagrams.label: Assembly Diagram - Exploded View of Vulcan OmniPro 220 Welder
diagrams.spatial: The diagram is a full-page exploded isometric view of the welder. The main machine chassis is centered. Numbered callouts radiate outward from all sides: callouts 1-7 run along the top-left area referencing the top/rear panels and handles; callouts 8-16 run along the left-center area referencing internal and side components; callouts 17-29 run along the far left referencing the front panel, display, wire feeder assembly, and torch/gun; callouts 26-43 run along the bottom referencing the bottom chassis, feet, and lower components; callouts 44-55 run along the right side referencing the side panel, fan, and internal boards; callouts 56-61 run along the top-right referencing the rear panel connectors and power input components.
